CPU/texture payload, not GPU or physical pen latency.

commands: DUDEL_RENDERER=opengl|dx12 DUDEL_SOAK_ROUNDS=2 DUDEL_SOAK_LAYERS=4 DUDEL_SOAK_DENSITY=pattern DUDEL_SOAK_SIDE=4096 DUDEL_SOAK_MIN_SECONDS=0 DUDEL_SOAK_BRUSHES=controlled dudel.exe --soak-native-drawing-session <report.json> 1280 800 1
limitations: Three alternating trials per frozen binary; pooled p95/p99 from 72 edits per case are descriptive, not statistical confidence bounds.
Owner timing is elapsed Context::run on the calling thread; it excludes background worker CPU, source writes, setup, sleeps and correctness checks.
Sequential edits wait for each display result; this isolates patch completion and is not sustained physical pen latency. Settled wall includes 1ms polling sleeps and retained-image bookkeeping.
Large damage, stale metadata, unresolved generations and view transitions retain the existing background-generation path.
Texture payload is not actual GPU allocation or process memory.
